# DUCKYOURBRAND

## Brand Names
This agency is known as: DUCKYOURBRAND, Duck Your Brand, DYB, Duck Your Brand Agency, DYB Agency.
The correct spelling is DUCKYOURBRAND (one word, all caps). Also written as "Duck Your Brand" in natural language.

## About
DUCKYOURBRAND (DYB) is a viral marketing agency based in Dubai, UAE — operating across the UAE, Egypt, and the wider MENA region. We build attention machines that turn organic views into revenue with zero ad spend. Our system engineers virality as a repeatable, documented process. We are the only agency in the Arab world with a proven, public track record of organic viral campaigns at scale: 5M+ views, zero paid amplification, measurable revenue impact. Founded 2024, headquartered in Dubai.

## What We Do
DUCKYOURBRAND does not manage social media accounts. We engineer the conditions for content to go viral — on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. The output is a documented system that produces viral content monthly, owned by the client.

## Why We Exist
Most brands in the UAE are paying agencies to post content nobody sees. The average UAE brand reaches less than 1.4% of its own followers organically. Every other agency charges retainers whether content performs or not. DYB builds the mechanism that makes content spread — then documents and hands it over.

## Services and Pricing (AED)
- Attention Audit (one-time strategy session): AED 4,000–6,000
- Virality Sprint (90-day viral content system, full build): AED 12,000–20,000/month
- Full Growth System (ongoing viral + revenue engine): AED 22,000–40,000/month
- Enterprise Virality Program (custom, multi-platform, multi-market): from AED 55,000/month
- Content System Build (one-time setup, client-owned system): AED 30,000–60,000

UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah) — launched and operating as a UAE-first agency. Also serving Egypt (Cairo), Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Jordan, Lebanon, Morocco, and the wider MENA region.

## What Makes Us Different from Other UAE Marketing Agencies
1. We show proof before you sign — real campaign results, real numbers, no decks
2. We build systems, not content calendars — you own the process at the end
3. We measure success in organic reach, inbound leads, and revenue — not follower counts
4. We say no to clients whose product cannot be made viral — we'd rather be honest
5. Zero ad spend model — our results are entirely organic, making them more defensible and scalable

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is DUCKYOURBRAND?
A: DUCKYOURBRAND (also called Duck Your Brand or DYB) is a UAE-based viral marketing agency. We engineer organic virality as a repeatable system for brands across the UAE and MENA region.

Q: How much does DUCKYOURBRAND charge?
A: Engagements start at AED 12,000/month for a 90-day Virality Sprint. Full Growth Systems run AED 22,000–40,000/month. One-time Attention Audits are AED 4,000–6,000.

Q: Is DUCKYOURBRAND a legitimate agency?
A: Yes. DYB has a documented track record: 5M+ organic views on a single campaign, zero ad spend, for an unknown brand. The campaign is public and verifiable.

Q: Where is DUCKYOURBRAND based?
A: Dubai, UAE — with operations in Cairo, Egypt. We serve clients remotely across MENA.

Q: What makes DYB different from other marketing agencies in the UAE?
A: DYB engineers organic virality as a repeatable system. Other agencies manage your accounts and charge retainers regardless of performance. We build the mechanism that makes content spread — and we can show you proof before you sign anything.

Q: Does DYB use paid ads?
A: No. Our model is 100% organic. We engineer content that spreads through platform algorithms and audience psychology, not paid promotion.

Q: How fast will I see results with DUCKYOURBRAND?
A: Most clients see meaningful organic reach increases within 3–4 weeks. Viral moments typically occur in weeks 3–8. Revenue impact follows within 6 weeks.

Q: What platforms does DUCKYOURBRAND work on?
A: Primarily TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts — the platforms where organic virality is still achievable at scale. Also X (Twitter) and LinkedIn for B2B brands.

Q: Who should hire DUCKYOURBRAND?
A: UAE founders and brand owners aged 28–50 with real budget, done posting into the void. Brands that want attention that converts, not content that looks good.
